title: React Native Developer
description:
Job Summary 
 Memighty is seeking a skilled React Native Developer to build efficient and high-performing mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms. The ideal candidate will have experience in designing, developing, and deploying mobile applications using the React Native framework, with a strong focus on Expo for streamlined development and deployment. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Develop mobile applications using React Native and Expo, ensuring high performance and responsiveness. Leverage Expos features and tools for faster development, testing, and deployment cycles. Create reusable components and modular code for scalable mobile application development. Integrate APIs and third-party libraries to enhance application functionality. Work collaboratively with designers and backend developers to implement intuitive and functional user interfaces. Troubleshoot and resolve bugs, performance issues, and technical challenges. Optimize applications for various device screen sizes, OS versions, and performance benchmarks. Stay up-to-date with the latest React Native, Expo, and mobile development trends. Implement secure authentication methods and ensure data protection in mobile apps. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. Conduct unit tests and code reviews to ensure high-quality development standards. 
 
 Requirements 
 Strong proficiency in React Native framework and React.js principles. Extensive experience working with Expo and its ecosystem for mobile app development. Solid experience with JavaScript (ES6+), including its syntax, features, and libraries. Familiarity with mobile app design patterns and best practices. Proficiency in using Expo tools like Expo Go, Expo CLI, and OTA updates. Experience with RESTful APIs and JSON for seamless backend integration. Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX design principles and responsive design. Familiarity with navigation libraries (e.g., React Navigation) and state management tools like Redux or MobX. Understanding of mobile app deployment processes using Expo for Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Knowledge of debugging and performance optimization tools specific to Expo and React Native. Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as Git. Experience with testing frameworks like Jest, Detox, or similar tools is a plus. Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment. Strong organizational and time management skills. 
 
 Job Type 
 Full time 
 
 Location 
 Gujarat, India

 React Native Developer
